nav.label: Desk
account.draft: Interface draft. English is the reviewed source. This translation has not had linguistic review.
account.zoneError: That time zone is not a recognised IANA name.
account.zoneNext: Choose a zone such as Europe/London or UTC.
account.prefError: Theme or density is not one of the available choices.
account.prefNext: Choose light, dark, or system, and comfortable or compact density.
account.localeError: That language is not in the catalogue.
account.localeNext: Choose a language from the list.
login.title: Sign in
login.lede: RETRACE is a public platform for scientists. Enter the name that should appear on your record. Each name is a separate account. There is no password in this build.
login.name: Display name
desk.title: Recover the analysis without changing what it means.
desk.lede: RETRACE keeps the original notebook, asks you to approve a result contract, and will not call a changed analysis reproduced. These three cases are labelled fixtures. The faults in them were injected.
desk.empty: Open a demonstration, or import an evidence bundle from a colleague.
case.ecology.title: Ecology measurements
case.ecology.copy: A path from another computer, a mean mass in grams, and a trap that drops a record.
case.trajectory.title: Trajectory length
case.trajectory.copy: A missing filename, a length that must stay in metres, and a trap that leaves centimetres in place.
case.assay.title: Assay table
case.assay.copy: A semicolon-separated table, a mean of every sample, and a trap that adds an exclusion.
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyLede: Download the record for this account, or delete the account from this service. Download leaves out session tokens and connector secrets. Deletion removes the projects, the session, and any saved token.
settings.exportError: The record could not be downloaded.
settings.exportNext: Stay signed in and try again.
settings.deleteLabel: Type your name to delete the account
settings.deleteError: The account could not be deleted.
settings.deleteNext: Check that the name matches the signed-in account, then try again.
settings.personal: Theme, density, language, and the clock are also in the account menu beside your name.
settings.sandbox: Curated demonstration notebooks only. No tested sandbox is configured, so other notebooks are refused.
settings.database: SQLite with application-enforced account separation. PostgreSQL row-level security is not claimed: no PostgreSQL server is configured.
settings.modelNote: Repairs stay with the deterministic diagnoser and are not sent to a model. The conversation assistant calls OpenRouter when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set on the desk server. Notebooks and stored results are not included. A spoken turn is sent only to transcribe it and to speak the reply. The service does not store the conversation.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lede: Times are stored in UTC. Google Calendar is not connected. If a local time happens twice, RETRACE asks which instant you mean.
wiki.title: Record
wiki.lede: Pages are assembled from the snapshot, the contract, and the runs. Missing evidence stays an abstention.
wiki.empty: Open a project before drafting a record. There is nothing to claim yet.
wiki.hint: The draft quotes project records. It does not invent a paper.
connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.lede: Connect the accounts you use for your own work. Working means this computer checked that account. You can then share a project, open it with someone else, or export it. The RETRACE application repository is not the destination.
connectors.create: If this name is new, create a private repository under the signed-in account.
connectors.noProjects: Open a project on the desk before sharing or exporting it.
connectors.github: No GitHub App credentials are configured.
connectors.slack: No Slack workspace installation is configured.
connectors.google_calendar: No Google Calendar OAuth client is configured. Internal events and ICS export work without it.
connectors.colab: No Colab session is connected. This is not a hosted execution backend.
connectors.mcp: RETRACE does not expose an MCP tool server in this build.
missing.title: That page is not on this desk.
missing.body: The address does not match a RETRACE view.
loading.title: Opening the record…
loading.body: The desk is reading the workstation service.
offline.title: The RETRACE service is not running.
offline.body: Start it from the project directory, then reload this page.
studio.noQuestion: No question has been recorded for this package.
studio.placeholder: Compare the repair and the checks
studio.promptNote: The prompt bar cannot approve or run.
studio.note.evidence: The evidence bundle and the checks it carries.
studio.note.notebook: The notebook and the proposed change.
studio.arrangeHelp: Drag a row, or use the buttons. Saving does not approve a repair or hide the status of a run.
snap.title: Untouched snapshot
snap.limited: Execution on this workstation is limited to this admitted demonstration.
snap.off: Execution on this workstation is turned off. No tested sandbox is configured.
contract.none: No result contract has been recorded. Nothing can be called reproduced.
contract.title: Result contracts
contract.approvedAt: Approved {when}. The repair cannot edit it.
review.title: Proposed changes
review.lede: A mechanical repair and a change of method are not the same decision. Method changes stay labelled as reanalysis.
review.author: Author {name}
review.noRepro: Approving this will not produce a reproduced status.
review.needContract: Approve a contract before approving this repair.
run.title: Run and compare
run.noSandbox: This package can be inspected. It will not run until a tested sandbox exists.
run.noApproval: No current approval. Approve a repair, then run that exact candidate.
evidence.title: Portable evidence
evidence.body: A downloaded bundle carries the snapshot, the patch, the contract, and a claimed status. Another account must rerun it. The claimed status is not a verification there.
evidence.caveat: Agreement with the contract is not proof that a scientific conclusion is correct. A notebook can still emit internally consistent numbers.
evidence.needRun: Finish a run before exporting evidence.
lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.lede: Observed relationships come from an admitted snapshot or a finished check. A repair that is only proposed is marked as such.
inspector.label: Inspector
inspector.empty: Select a contract or a repair.
inspector.limitBody: A matching number does not establish that the scientific conclusion is correct.
talk.title: Conversation
talk.lede: Speak or type. Live talk listens, answers, then listens again. It cannot approve a contract, change a notebook, or assign a reproduction result.
talk.checking: Checking whether the assistant is configured…
talk.notStored: This page does not save the conversation.
talk.needs: The OpenRouter key is not set on this server.
talk.needsNext: Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the Vercel environment, then reload. Nothing is sent until then.
talk.voiceExact: {name}, {country}. The tone is {tone}. The voice style is {style}.
talk.voiceClosest: {name}, {country}. The tone is {tone}. The voice style is {style}. This service has no {gender} voice for {asked} at that tone, so this is the closest voice.
talk.micNext: Allow the microphone for this page, or type the message.
talk.speechError: The reply is on the page, and the voice did not play.
talk.hearError: The recording could not be transcribed.
talk.playback: The reply is on the page. The browser blocked the sound.
talk.playbackNext: Use the text, or allow sound for this page.
